name: gh-ui
description: GitHub-style web component library (light DOM custom elements)

scripts.export: node build-icons.mjs && esbuild src/index.js --bundle --format=iife --minify --outfile=dist/gh-ui.js && node export-demo.mjs
scripts.export:test: node build-icons.mjs && esbuild src/index.js --bundle --format=iife --minify --outfile=dist/gh-ui.js && node export-demo.mjs demo/test-combo.html dist/gh-ui-test-combo.html
scripts.export:trace: node build-icons.mjs && esbuild src/index.js --bundle --format=iife --minify --outfile=dist/gh-ui.js && node export-demo.mjs demo/trace.html dist/gh-ui-trace.html
scripts.export:nested: node build-icons.mjs && esbuild src/index.js --bundle --format=iife --minify --outfile=dist/gh-ui.js && node export-demo.mjs demo/test-nested.html dist/gh-ui-test-nested.html
